body:
Photographs from the EXCHANGE kick-off meeting, held at the Institute of Marine Biology in Kotor, Montenegro, on 11 September 2020.

Partners from Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro gathered to coordinate the implementation of Explore Cross-border Aquatic Biodiversity. Discussions addressed project objectives, partner responsibilities, forthcoming activities and communication arrangements. Partners also agreed on Blue Pass as the name of their shared tourism product.

The photographs capture the meeting and the preparation and exchange of partnership agreement documentation, recording the cooperation behind the project’s launch.

Read more about the meeting.
